reason: I'd take the free first visit on a Saturday for sure, and probably pay for one more drop-in if my kid liked it. I'd go once or twice a month at most, so a membership makes no sense for us.
objection: We'd only go once or twice a month, so $45 unlimited or even the $60 pack is not worth it, and with daycare costs up I'm watching every recurring charge. $15 a weekend visit adds up fast.
would_change_my_mind: A pay-per-visit price closer to $10 on weekends, or a pack that doesn't expire so I can use it slowly.
